title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-sj6v: misleading test name for restored_context_rejects_response_without_piv
description: Test restored_context_rejects_response_without_piv (line 2756) calls protect_response() with include_piv=true, but the test name says without_piv. This conflicts with the recent implementation change that rejects all protect_response calls on restored contexts (not just without-piv ones). Either rename the test to reflect the actual behavior (rejects all responses) or confirm the implementation intent.
